title: "Intermediate folders"
guide-section: "Output"
---

# Intermediate folders

Besides its main and final `outputs/` folder, NextPyper creates a `workflow/` folder, where data of intermediate steps of the workflow are stored, and a `logs/` folder, where logs generated by those steps are recorded.

In both cases, numbers that prefix the directory names indicate approximately the stage order and hierarchy of execution.

<script>
function toggleTree(openState) {
  const tree = document.getElementById('interactive-file-tree');
  if (!tree) return;
  const detailsList = tree.querySelectorAll('details');
  detailsList.forEach(detail => {
    detail.open = openState;
  });
}
</script>
